reason: The plugin is a media capture utility for DSH Web: it adds a screenshot button to the composer, lets users capture and crop screen regions (including optional window-hiding), and places the result as a message-attached image card for sending. Evidence in the README clearly defines this as the core user-facing function, with PowerShell capture/crop scripts and dedicated screenshot API routes.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Web 对话框提供微信风格截图功能，可在界面中拖拽选择区域、裁剪后将截图卡片放入输入区并发送。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a WeChat-style screenshot feature to the DSH web composer, allowing users to select and crop a screen region and send it as an image card in the chat input.

capabilities: Captures full-screen screenshots on Windows via local PowerShell scripts and optional window hiding
Provides browser-side screen-region selection and server-side coordinate-based PNG cropping
Injects screenshot path references into the chat composer message flow and exposes local API routes for capture/preview/crop/delete

reasons.code: README describes POST /api/screenshot/capture and /api/screenshot/crop endpoints backed by screenshot.ps1 and crop.ps1 with local PNG generation and image card injection.
README explicitly states image cards are attached in the DSH composer input area and send as a screenshot path for model vision tools to read.
README includes local-file lifecycle behavior (temporary screenshot IDs, cleanup on cancel/restart, and local upload directory usage) and loopback + same-origin route constraints.
